Questions

Plain replies, no fog.

What does Kaivo actually do?

It stores a steady pool of value that software can burn through across many engines, with routing and bookkeeping looked after.

What is kCASH?

The accounting unit for that pool, held at parity with its reserve so a figure keeps its meaning.

Why are some slots marked pending?

Whatever lacks confirmation is marked pending rather than guessed. Links, addresses and rates surface only after they are stated.

Is the market board tied to the token?

No. It reads a public index spanning the entire network and keeps running whatever happens with a contract.

Which networks are in scope?

Elysium leads, with BNB Chain and Base next to it.

Is any of this financial advice?

No. Market numbers originate with an outside provider and appear untouched.

Hand your software a purse with brains.

Watch the board, keep an eye on the records as they firm up, and return once the gaps close.
